title: Formal Conjectures (Solved Literature): Number Theory
description: Twenty-five known-in-literature, unproved-in-Lean number theory theorems extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0), including 11 FC100SolvedSet2 benchmarks (Ball–Rivoal odd zeta irrationality, Darmon–Granville Fermat–Catalan, Baker–Heegner–Stark class number 1, Alford–Granville–Pomerance Carmichael lower bound, Wooley sums of three cubes, Hardy's divisor error, Ford's Carmichael totient bound, Tao's 2017 lonely runner bound, Gourevitch's series, Boshernitzan) plus Erdős Discrepancy (#67), large prime gaps (#4), Graham's GCD conjecture (#402), and Ternary Goldbach. All statements compile cleanly on Lean 4.36.0 + Mathlib v4.36.0 with zero open-PR conflicts.
